fusions.name: Grey Point Home
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 24 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Chilling Hedge
fusions.desc: Thrusts through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 7 frost damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance to leave each enemy [Slowed] for 3 seconds. You hold up to 3 thrusts, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Planted Guard
fusions.desc: Raises a guard that absorbs the next 22 damage, up to 4 blows, for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 10%.

fusions.name: Unbending Grey
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 5% sooner. Your armour rises by 10%.
